name: frontend-spec-plugin
description: Turns approved requirements, Figma UI, and API contracts into a frontend specification, scoped dashboard implementation, and visual validation.

interface.shortDescription: Specify, restore, and visually validate dashboard frontend features.
interface.longDescription: A frontend-focused delivery pipeline that confirms where frontend-spec will be created, collects missing requirement, prototype, and API inputs, isolates each feature specification, and for implementation requests restores an approved Figma frame in the explicitly selected dashboard-ui scope with design and regression visual testing. It does not scan the surrounding project for background.
defaultPrompt: Add a dashboard frontend feature. First collect the PRD, node-specific Figma prototype, API contract, exact frontend-spec output location, target page, and authorized frontend path; then specify, implement, and visually validate it.
Generate only an implementation-ready frontend specification from my requirement, prototype, and API contract, after I confirm the exact frontend-spec output path.
Restore this dashboard page from Figma: create an approval brief before editing, stay inside my selected frontend path, and run design plus regression visual tests.
